name: Booking and the diary
short: Customers book a real free time and pay a deposit. It lands in the right diary.
long: A diary with a lane for each person, travel time between jobs, and the deposit on every online booking. Book as a customer from their phone and watch the slot appear; move a job, send an on-my-way text, or mark it done and the review ask queues itself.
proves: Nobody books and vanishes, and nobody plays phone tag for a time.
features: Day and week views with a lane for each person
Online booking from real free times, with a deposit
On-my-way texts, moving a job, and marking it done
A finished job queues its own review ask
story: The booking page and the diary are the same thing, so what a customer books at 10pm is in the right van’s diary by morning.
